title: Generalized Fermat equation over number fields
summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$, and let $A,B,C \in \mathcal{O}_K \setminus\{0\}$. Denote by $S_K'$ the set of prime ideals of $\mathcal{O}_K$ dividing $2ABC$. Assuming two standard conjectures concerning the modularity of mod-$p$ Galois representations and the Eichler-Shimura correspondence over number fields, we study the asymptotic behavior of the generalized Fermat equation $Ax^p+By^p+Cz^p=0$ over $K$.
